decisionTree.requirementName: Password strength for factory default passwords

nodes.text: Is the password enforced to be changed by the user before or on first use?
Is the password unique per equipment?
Does the password follow best practice concerning strength?
The password change is correctly enforced before or on first use.
The factory default password is unique and follows best practices concerning strength.
The password is not unique per equipment.
